svg.title: Correctness prediction measurement and explanation
svg.desc: A correctness gate precedes six small-model cells or a conditional larger sweep. Predict work and memory boundaries, then measure completed requests with warmup and paired trials. Explain with independent profile evidence and remeasure end to end. Count savings alone do not prove speed.
svg.text: From a length sweep to a defensible explanation
1. Correctness: same model, IDs, positions, stopping and numerical budget
Prefix-controlled checks + free-running trajectory; fresh valid request KV
2. Predict: vary P or g; count phase work and name memory boundaries
Tiny model: 6 valid cells; larger model: separate conditional 9-cell grid
3. Measure: warmups excluded; paired trials; actual output and outcomes
Completed request first; phase/gap detail and profiler runs kept separate
4. Explain and remeasure: supported mechanism or explicit uncertainty
Twofold decode-only change in the fixture: 74 → 65.5 μs total
Counted work savings alone are not an observed speedup.
If correctness fails, repair the contract before drawing timing conclusions.
